calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, 
           f.member_key, 
           f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year,
       d.fiscal_period,
       SUM(l.net_amount) AS web_sales_before_returns,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS member_web_sales,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_amount), 1) AS member_share_pct
FROM web_lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period;

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, 
           f.member_key, 
           f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB'
      AND s.store_id <> 999
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year,
       d.fiscal_period,
       SUM(l.net_amount) AS web_sales_before_returns,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS member_web_sales,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_amount), 1) AS member_share_pct
FROM web_lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period;
